## For a look

- [ ] The folder `looks/<id>/` holds `look.json`, `meta.json` and `preview.webp`, and nothing else.
- [ ] `meta.json` has `id` (same as the folder), `name` (40 characters or fewer), `author` and `licence` (CC0-1.0, CC-BY-4.0, CC-BY-SA-4.0 or MIT).
- [ ] The look is my own work, or its licence lets me share it under the licence I chose.
- [ ] `preview.webp` is a still WebP of 96 KiB or less, at most 1024 by 1024 pixels.
- [ ] The look holds only style: no actions, entities, templates or outside addresses.

The `look-ci` check runs on every pull request and must pass before merge.
